name: io.github.walidsadfi-evolurise/woocommerce-mcp-server
title: WooCommerce (human approval gate)
description: Read a WooCommerce store (orders, products, customers) with PII masked; writes need human approval

packageArguments.description: Start the stdio transport (the image defaults to the HTTP transport).

environmentVariables.name: WOO_CONSUMER_KEY
environmentVariables.description: WooCommerce REST API consumer key (read permission is enough for the read tools)

environmentVariables.name: WOO_ALLOW_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to let approved proposals be applied; default false (read-only)

environmentVariables.name: WOO_REDACT_PII
environmentVariables.description: Mask customer emails, phones, names and street addresses; default true
